verdicts.title: Over-general or contradicted behavior claims: docstrings state one of N cases as universal, or contradict the adjacent code/doc

Trivial repair: restore the em-dash in both texts. Everything else verified sound: all 11 checklist lines present (fields.pyi 4-7 + 7 correctly share one edit); sizedview branch facts match _SizedView.__getattr__ (structs.py:1221-1230: nested Struct -> child's sizedview, Array -> AttributeError, scalar -> BoundField); array() endian/default claim matches the signature at 648-657; float-box channel runtime-verified (Float has __float__, no __index__); fixed.py frombytes/fromfile runtime-raise ValueError; find() clause matches its own rfind (1344-1345) and native find (1346-1347); bittype 535-537 replacement matches the authoritative property docstring (558-560) and code ('>' always). The one CODE fix checks out: bwbs __contains__ before verbatim (882-884), item is provably always a bitarray at the tail (all paths convert or return False -- runtime-tested with object(), 2, 0, a subsequence, and a plain bitarray), so assert + unconditional return is behavior-identical on every reachable path; BOTH siblings confirmed (native 908-910 and speedup 992-994 use assert + unconditional return); the future-AssertionError surface is flagged in risks as required. Nit: the native __init__ edit says 'replace the restated buffer/source story' but the docstring continues with the source bullet list (268+); state explicitly how much of the docstring the one-line deferral replaces.

verdicts.title: AI-tone trims: metaphors, chatty fillers, marketing reassurance, em-dash triads, and a restating comment
verdicts.issues: RESOLVED by revision: (1) restored both buffer.py em-dashes (lines 85 and 90) in the before-text and after-text, so the keyword-only/Buffer16 lines are truly kept verbatim and only the door metaphor changes; all three before-blocks re-verified verbatim against the repo. Original issue: Three real problems. (1) NON-VERBATIM BEFORE + internal contradiction: buffer.py 85 and 90 both use em-dashes in the source ('in **bytes** — the C', 'names its unit — this class's history'); the before-text has ASCII hyphens, and the fix explicitly promises to 'Keep the keyword-only rationale and Buffer16 history verbatim' while its own after-text renders those very lines with hyphens -- applying it silently rewrites punctuation it promised not to touch. Either add a checklist line for the 190 comment or fix the test expectation to 1. (3) Sweep-grep conflict: 'rg only really -> expect 0' collides with bitvector-behavior-6's ACCEPTED after-text, which reintroduces 'only really be true/false' twice in bwbs __eq__/__ne__; the conditional coordination note ('only align wording there if behavior-6's text does not already differ') technically covers it but the grep expectation as stated is wrong post-behavior-6. Verified good: bwbs 125-135 otherwise verbatim (including the line-134 em-dash); native 175-178 template verbatim; speedup 789-791 and 1856-1858 verbatim; NotImplemented claim runtime-true (speedup __eq__ line 794); behavior-5 ordering claim accurate (it rewrites the alias docstring head in all three backends and leaves the 'Please note' tail, so applying after it is right); buffer-1's accepted text really does echo 'the Struct-field door' (one-decision-two-lines coordination is real); buffer-1 moot of 40-45 genuine (deletes the orphan literal). The 'just works' voice call is sane: exactly 2 occurrences repo-wide (fields.py:13, __init__.py:19), both July-era (ref_4wks has no .py sources; __init__ text postdates the reference), and the proposal correctly makes it an explicit maintainer Option A/B with a recorded decision rather than a mandated deletion.
